verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a markup and document converter (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, docx, PDF and similar). Transcoding raster or vector image files with control over quality, size and compression belongs to a different product category, so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc shipping image-format conversion that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression
